executive_summary: Reworkd is an AI agent platform designed to automate browser-based workflows, targeting small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Founded in 2023 by Srijan Subedi, who has a background in clinical research, the company is part of the Y Combinator W25 batch, indicating early traction. With a focus on simplifying workflow automation for SMBs, Reworkd shows promise in a growing market.
team: Srijan Subedi is the founder of Reworkd AI, with a combined major in Science from UBC and experience as a Clinical Researcher at STEMCELL Technologies and Heart Lung Innovation.
product: An AI agent platform that automates workflows performed in web browsers.
market: The product targets small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) looking for workflow automation solutions.
traction_signals: Part of Y Combinator W25 batch, indicating early traction.
risks: Limited team size (only 1 founder) may impact execution capacity.
As a newly founded company (2023), it may face challenges in market penetration.
thesis_alignment: Reworkd fits the investment thesis as it targets SMBs with a technically strong founder and has visible traction through its participation in Y Combinator.
change_my_mind: Evidence of early customer adoption or feedback.
Additional team members with relevant experience.
Clearer differentiation from competitors in the workflow automation space.
